exclusions: Newly touched keys pay full affected routes.
Shared catalog pays full price because entries have different target payers.
Failed or cancelled construction and takeover disable reuse until a successful checkpoint.
charges_unchanged: Each transaction pays its journal, new value/receipt rows and their split/manifest allowance.
Actual maintenance attempts still claim their complete copy and construction allowance.
No budget increase, refund, or reconstructed grant.

model.name: TenantAdmission
model.bounds: Two tenants, one grant, at most two writes per tenant, one base change, one takeover and three construction attempts; lost replies/refills.
model.limitations: Bounded credit protocol; byte/key coverage is guarded in Rust tests. No Rust refinement, complete composed protocol proof or liveness proof.

limitations: No sustained-load, fixed-arrival overload, mixed-workload or latency SLO claim.
Final live values and revisions are verified; overwritten historical values and cold recovery are not checked by this workload.
Ten-second controller sampling can miss resource peaks; kubelet observations have their own timestamps. CPU intervals use those timestamps.
CPU averages include setup. RSS and working-set counters are different approximate measures.
The same configured workloads and ceilings use new random database names, placement and provider conditions; this short sample does not isolate causal latency/throughput gains.
This change addresses excess copy prepayment. Remote call costs, write grouping, ambiguous-upload recovery and sustained performance remain open.
No repeated cold cluster/fault campaign in this follow-up; local exact-artifact kill/reopen and targeted owner-replacement tests pass.

cleanup.removed: Replaced repeated base-copy precharging for covered overwrites; reused the existing projection and maintenance flags. Removed local model scratch directories; disposable cloud resources are confirmed removed in the experiment.
